section: AVI-SPL end-user technology training services: training formats, materials and stated benefits
body:
AVI-SPL's end-user technology training services teach a workforce to operate its workplace technology. The page describes the purpose of the training, the formats on offer and the benefits AVI-SPL attributes to it.

**Purpose**
- Raise user engagement and collaboration by giving the workforce detailed knowledge of the technology, for better teamwork and productivity.
- The programs follow a consistent, standardized approach to learning in any location.
- The stated goal is that each user has the ability and confidence to operate workplace solutions efficiently.

**Training formats and materials**
- Quick start guides: in-room reinforcement and reference.
- Video tutorials: custom videos available on demand.
- Flip books: detailed documentation that walks through common conference room scenarios.
- Virtual training: interactive learning for large groups and remote teams.
- QR code access: training content reached through a QR code or a URL link.
- Onsite Training: hands-on training from experts, in multiple formats and for any audience.

**Benefits AVI-SPL lists**
- Higher productivity and efficiency
- More collaboration between onsite and remote teams
- Better morale and employee experience
- Lower travel expenses
- Better recruiting
- A greater return on technology (ROI)
- Streamlined operations that support competitive advantage

**When to use this**
Use it when a customer asks how users will be trained on new meeting-room technology, what materials can be left in the rooms, or whether training can be delivered remotely and across several locations.

**Not stated in this source**: prices, course length, class sizes, or measured results for the listed benefits.
